Done. I've implemented all three functions:

- **formatBytes(n)** in src/util.js: Divides by 1024 through units (B, KB, MB, GB) and formats with one decimal place.
- **slugify(title)** in src/text.js: Lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, and strips non-alphanumeric characters except dashes.
- **fetchUsers(baseUrl)** in src/api.js: Fetches from `${baseUrl}/api/users`, logs the count, and returns the parsed JSON array.

All three are exported from their modules.
